metadata.rendererClock: Inner performance.now clock around synchronous band.replace(records). Sparse and jump are single calls. Scroll totals sum 31 calls across 32 stock-controller scroll steps. Excludes correctness checks, dispatch, and layout and paint after the call.
metadata.presentationClock: Stock scale fixture Chromium Element Timing of visible status marker relative to trusted click handler entry. Final cell also hit-tested outside clock.
metadata.order: Fresh Chromium per arm/round. Per round cyclic permutation of arms. Jump first via trusted sparse update and jump clicks; separate new browser context/page/model for overlapping scroll.

reproduction.instructions: Build the existing scale bundles with the frozen toolchain (node benchmarks/frameworks/build.mjs --scale --compiled-saba after installing the benchmark package dependencies). Write each sources entry to its filename in a temporary directory. Save the manifest below there as arms.json, replacing REPLAY_DIRECTORY with the absolute path of that directory. From the Saba checkout run node /path/to/ceiling.cjs /path/to/arms.json 12 /path/to/output.json. Set PLAYWRIGHT_PATH to the installed Playwright package if needed. Method and clock definitions are in metadata.
